title: teratophyllum rotundifoliatum
intro: Teratophyllum rotundifoliatum, commonly known as the Round-leaved Tassel Fern, is a species of plant in the family Dryopteridaceae. It has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and treat digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Teratophyllum rotundifoliatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, alkaloids, and other compounds that exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's potential health benefits, such as its ability to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation.
